shortDescription: Change permissive domain in SELinux policy

options.name: domain
options.description: The domain that is added or removed from the list of permissive domains.

options.name: no_reload
options.description: Disable reloading of the SELinux policy after making change to a domain's permissive setting. The default is V(false), which causes policy to be reloaded when a domain changes state. Reloading the policy does not work on older versions of the C(policycoreutils-python) library, for example in EL 6.".

options.name: permissive
options.description: Indicate if the domain should or should not be set as permissive.

options.name: store
options.description: Name of the SELinux policy store to use.
